name: Tanzaku Card
description: Narrow paper strips tied to a line by short threads, each a damped pendulum that swings and twists when touched and stirs its neighbours.

props.name: children
props.description: Tanzaku strips, hung left to right along a cord that sags a little between its ends.

props.name: breeze
props.description: Idle sway from a passing breeze, from 0 (still air) to 1. Pointer movement across a strip pushes it whatever the breeze.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the line. Its width sets the length of the cord; the strips are centred along it.

props.name: writing
props.description: Set the text top to bottom, or upright across the strip.

props.name: children
props.description: What is written on the strip. Keep it to a short line.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the strip, which is 64px by 240px. It is focusable: the arrow keys push it left or right, Enter and Space give it a nudge.
